key_insight: Increasing the turbulent Damköhler number reduces turbulent diffusion of droplets and water vapour while increasing their mutual cross-diffusion.
engineering_relevance: These theoretical relationships could improve atmospheric transport models that couple turbulent mixing with condensation and evaporation.
method: Theoretical analysis of turbulent droplet and water-vapour transport with phase transitions.
Relate diffusion coefficients to the turbulent Damköhler number: integral-scale turbulent time divided by condensation time.
Examine strong suppression of droplet diffusion when evaporation is much faster than condensation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical trends but provides no experimental or numerical validation data.
watch_item: Applicability and parameterization should be validated for the atmospheric conditions of interest before implementation.
paper_title: Effect of humidity and phase transition on turbulent diffusion of droplets and water vapour in atmospheric turbulent flows
